title: Hebbian Learning Principles for Updating Concept Vectors Without Full Re-extraction

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: online-updatable safety vectors would allow rapid adaptation to emerging threats. However, whether a Hebbian update rule actually works for high-dimensional concept vectors is highly speculative; it may not maintain accuracy.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing a custom online learning rule for concept vectors, validating it maintains accuracy without degradation, and comparing to full re-extraction requires ML research experience beyond beginner level. The theoretical grounding in Hebbian learning is non-trivial to translate correctly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Moderately focused: implement update rule, test on misclassified examples, compare to baseline. The scope is tractable if limited to a single concept, but validating that online updates do not degrade requires careful experimental design.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
